source.title: Announcement of the WDPC Leader
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Ronald Mansveld has been appointed as the Leader of the WCA Data Protection Committee (WDPC).


Ronald was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a voting among the current Committee/Team Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.


We wish Ronald the best of luck in fulfilling his new duty!


Ronald Mansveld was the only applicant for the position. His candidacy document can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/122QfMLhjVWWJsvJIquJ4aPJeF7Txz5OP/view) if you are interested in viewing it.

translation.title: WCA 数据保护委员会负责人任命公告
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Ronald Mansveld 已获任命为 WCA 数据保护委员会（WDPC）负责人。

依照 WCA 委员会与团队[动议 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Ronald，并经现任委员会、团队负责人和高级代表投票批准。

祝 Ronald 在新的岗位上工作顺利！

Ronald Mansveld 是本次职位的唯一申请人。有兴趣的成员可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/file/d/122QfMLhjVWWJsvJIquJ4aPJeF7Txz5OP/view)查看他的申请材料。
